title: A draft holiday itinerary is approved
turns: Here's where I've landed for the Marrow Coast weekend. Friday ferry at 08:40, two nights at the Saltwick harbour guesthouse, the cliff path ride to Quillmere on Saturday, and the 18:10 ferry home on Sunday.
Yes, let's go with that itinerary. Hold Sunday morning free and tell me what I still need to book.
